softwareChecks.keyboardMouse: pass locally: held Space 600 ms remains crouched after release; 60 ms tap stands without jumping; separate 60 ms tap jumps (height 0.75 captured). Left click picked up Painted chest; right click returned it. Drag changed the view. Pointer capture rejected by preview browser and drag fallback displayed. Wheel zoom showed 1.1x; middle click reset view; right click then returned the artifact. Unit tests cover threshold, repeat, stalled frames, cancellation and zoom bounds.
softwareChecks.screenControls: pass locally: H hides HUD, toolbar and action buttons while retaining direction arrows and screen toggles; button restores interface. F enters and exits browser full screen. 844×390 iframe layout checked in both states. A fixture that denies fullscreen permissions displays Home Screen web-app instructions, with close restoring the walkthrough. Keyboard C, Space, E, Q and Z/X badges remain after label updates; E pickup and Q return tested on the mask. Standalone manifest and Apple web-app metadata added; physical Home Screen installation not tested.
softwareChecks.compactHud: pass locally: identical bottom panels in both Cardboard eyes, no world-space status sprite or central toast overlay. H toggles shortcut lines; right-eye Exit VR works. 844×390 iframe checked in Cardboard and hidden-HUD landscape; bottom information fits while direction arrows remain. Controller hints switch from keyboard hints when a pad is connected; physical controller remains untested.
softwareChecks.inspectionZoom: pass: dynamic closest distance based on camera-space mesh bounding-box corners plus near plane and 0.05 m clearance. Geometry limits cached until object rotation changes. Repeated wheel input reached the surface stop on Painted chest; rotating at the limit remains clamped. Cardboard wheel zoom and middle-click reset tested. Unit tests cover thin/deep objects, rotation push-out and zoom bounds.
